target.statement: OKMeans2 (Algorithm 1b) achieves Cost Best = 5.768e4 on SKIN-5 (best among all methods), with Cost Mean 6.410e4 and Recall 0.746
target.dataset: SKIN-5 (SKIN dataset, 245,057 x 3, k=10, 1% synthetic outliers from [-5,5]^d)

compute.basis: SKIN is a small public UCI dataset (~245k x 3); the method is KNN scoring on a 24k coreset plus k-means, all CPU-friendly, but the repo must be checked/adapted and the exact outlier-injection seed and coreset sampling are not fully specified, so a few runs to match the reported best/mean cost are needed.

blockers: Exact synthetic outlier generation seed/order and coreset sampling procedure not fully specified, so exact reproduction of the reported best cost may differ slightly
Repo completeness (configs for SKIN-5, baseline reimplementations) unverified
title: Simple KNN-Based Outlier Detection Achieves Robust Clustering
